text:
White to move. One knight move ends the game on the spot.

Black's king is boxed in on h8 by its own rook and pawns.

What is White's only winning move? ♟️

docked_reply.text:
Solution: 1. Nf7# (Smothered Mate).
The knight delivers check, and the king cannot escape because g8, g7, and h7 are blocked.
